svg.title: Michelson interferometer — displacement
svg.desc: Editable library-based Michelson interferometer with a translating mirror and small-area photodiode readout. Optical paths schematic. Delta OPD = 2 delta x, delta phase = 4 pi delta x / lambda. Reference: https://www.thorlabs.com/catalogpages/obsolete/2018/EDU-MINT1_M.pdf

g.inkscape:label: Title and footer
g.text: Mirror displacement measured through interference fringes
